# WakeelBano

> Career platform for Pakistani lawyers, starting in Karachi. It helps law students, fresh graduates and junior advocates find a chamber and mentor, verified rooms and seat sharing near the courts, paid drafting work, and free case law research guides. Junior lawyers use it free; chambers, firms and universities pay.

Key facts: founded 2026, based in Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan. Legal information only, not legal advice. No commission on client case referrals, and no lawyer rankings. Guidance is drawn from Pakistani statutes, bar council notifications and official court publications, with sources listed on every page.

## Core pages
- [What WakeelBano is: a career platform for Pakistani lawyers; who it serves and how it is funded.](https://wakeelbano.com/)
- [Entity page: what the platform does, what it deliberately does not do, and how content is produced.](https://wakeelbano.com/about/)
